meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从论文中快速获取方法、结果、样本量等结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured experimental details from scientific papers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能搜索科学论文并返回结构化实验数据，包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分等详细字段。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索科学论文、获取具体实验结果或做文献综述时触发。

say.text: 搜索关于CRISPR基因编辑效率的论文。
say.note: 返回相关论文的结构化结果。

say.text: 帮我找肺癌临床试验的样本量数据。
say.note: 获取包含样本量信息的论文。

say.note: 返回效应量等定量数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search scientific papers and return structured experimental data including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and 25+ metadata fields.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search for scientific papers, retrieve specific experimental results, or conduct a literature review.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Returns structured results from relevant papers.

say_en.text: Find sample size data from clinical trials on lung cancer.
say_en.note: Retrieves papers with sample size information.

say_en.text: Compare effect sizes of CRISPR across studies.
say_en.note: Returns quantitative data like effect sizes.
